data.description: Modern Studio Apartment for Rent | Skyhills Residences
data.display_address: Skyhills Residences 2, Skyhills Residences, Dubai Science Park, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern urban living in this beautifully designed studio apartment at Skyhills Residences, situated in the rapidly growing Dubai Science Park community. Perfect for professionals, this unit combines comfort, convenience, and premium finishes.

Property Details:

-Type: Studio Apartment
-Size: 454.88 Sq Ft
-Bathroom: 1
-Parking: 1 Covered Space
-Status: Available on next month 

Apartment Features:

-Open-plan living and sleeping area with a modern layout
-Fully furnished with high-quality furniture and branded appliances
-Sleek, contemporary kitchen with built-in cabinets
-Built-in wardrobes for optimal storage
-Premium porcelain tile flooring throughout
-Floor-to-ceiling windows filling the space with natural light
-Private balcony offering serene community views

Building & Community Amenities:
Residents enjoy access to world-class facilities, including:

-Sandy beach-style pool, lazy river, lap pool, and kids’ pool
-Indoor and outdoor gyms, yoga areas, and a 325m jogging track
-BBQ areas, co-working spaces, and a residents’ lounge
-Convenience is key, with on-site retail options such as a quick mart, pharmacy, beauty salon, and barbershop. Additional perks include 24/7 security, covered parking, and maintenance services.

Prime Location:

Enjoy easy access to major roads and be just a short drive away from Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Hills Mall, placing shopping, dining, and entertainment at your doorstep.
